hotspots.title: AI Executive Summit with Trump
hotspots.blurb: President Trump hosted top artificial intelligence leaders at the White House to discuss industry self-policing, promising not to stifle technological innovation. The high-profile summit generated intense coverage around safety risks, regulatory disputes, and internal administration maneuvering ahead of the meeting.
hotspots.affect: The summit serves as a major battlefield over government regulation versus free-market tech development, drawing intense focus from both industry proponents and safety advocates.

hotspots.title: Fuel Economy Standards Rollback
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration finalized significant rollbacks to vehicle fuel economy standards, reversing Biden-era targets down to 34.9 mpg by 2031. Officials framed the decision as a victory for vehicle affordability, while opposition figures warned of environmental and economic fallout.
hotspots.affect: The policy shift provides a high-charge focal point for conservative triumphs over federal climate regulations and economic grievance over car prices.

hotspots.title: Trump Administration Legal Contempt Battles
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is embroiled in mounting legal battles over immigration, facing potential contempt proceedings over Venezuelan deportations and Green Card lottery pauses. Simultaneously, the Supreme Court granted a temporary stay permitting rapid third-country deportations to continue during legal appeals.
hotspots.affect: The legal escalation sparks intense polarization between supporters celebrating aggressive border enforcement and critics alleging defiance of federal court orders.

hotspots.title: Midterm Campaign Blitz and Presidents Cup Tour
hotspots.blurb: President Trump launched an energetic campaign tour featuring midterm rallies across several key states alongside high-profile appearances at major sporting events. His presence at crowded venues stirred strong reactions from attendees and mobilized base enthusiasm for endorsed local candidates.
hotspots.affect: The campaign blitz functions as a high-visibility spectacle designed to demonstrate movement strength and rally political loyalty.

hotspots.title: FrP Campaign Against High Fuel Taxes
hotspots.blurb: Norway's Progress Party (FrP) launched an aggressive campaign against record-high pump prices exceeding 31 kroner per liter, demanding the reintroduction of fuel tax cuts. Party leader Sylvi Listhaug directed severe criticism at political rivals for refusing to offer immediate relief to motorists.
hotspots.affect: The issue channels acute cost-of-living grievances into a populist rallying cry against political inaction and high fuel taxation.
